scientific_integrity: General theorem follows from a complete case split of exact witness equations; finite enumeration only checks examples. The 2022 authors' primary-conjugacy and idempotent results are credited, and only their Otto subquestion is claimed resolved.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for witnesses in the maximal-antichain incidence monoid of a height-two poset, not the full incidence monoid. The finite-field counts require finite fields of prime-power cardinality. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible; an independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Complete Otto-conjugacy classification for bipartite antichain monoids
